scope: all supplied actual historical content and retrieved candidate content; no account ledgers or weights
exposure_definition: historical benchmark questions/images used in model calls, train seed/reflection, retrieved candidate or injected memory content, or published reports; source-data storage/preprocessing alone is not exposure
not_established: does not detect model pretraining contamination or guarantee patient disjointness

encoding.source_files: Relative provenance paths. reports/ paths refer to this repository; other root aliases refer to archived historical run exports.
encoding.case_source_indices: Lossless replacement of the original case_sources strings; each integer indexes source_files. Every listed case is excluded for historical actual-content exposure.
encoding.qid_linked_legacy_case_aliases: Each row is [source_file_index, field_name, legacy_hash_alias, explicit_qid_resolved_case_ids]; no case was inferred from a qid prefix.

metadata_only_inventories_not_exposure.reason: complete metadata registry; no question, image bytes, prediction or reference content
complete metadata registry; no question, image bytes, prediction or reference content

isolated_reference_stores_not_exposure.reason: isolated source reference store; actual scoring/feedback records are covered separately
